extracted.intended_audience: grant writers and proposal developers (nonprofit, academic, and government)
extracted.subtask_short: using census data for grant writing
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on locating and using U.S. Census Bureau data products, tools, and apps to identify key indicators and build a demographic profile to support grant proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include key indicators and data points from Census in proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Census Bureau data provides key indicators and data points for including in a grant proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Census statistics to substantiate needs, describe populations served, and provide evidence-based justification for funding requests. (This webinar is framed around identifying those indicators.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Be able to navigate census.gov to capture needed information
rubrics_metrics.description: This webinar will help you successfully navigate census.gov to capture the information you need to support your grant writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learn site navigation, search strategies, and where to find tables and datasets relevant to your service area or target population so you can extract appropriate variables and geographies for proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Census Bureau products, data tools, and apps to create a community demographic profile
rubrics_metrics.description: You will be guided to key Census Bureau products and data tools and APPS that can help you create a demographic profile of your community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify which Census products (e.g., ACS, Decennial Census) and online tools/apps to use, and assemble selected variables into a coherent demographic profile for inclusion in grant narratives, attachments, or needs assessments. See the linked Census Academy webinar materials for examples and step-by-step demonstrations.
